blessing: Resounding Moon — When a character triggers Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct reaction on an opponent, they gain 1 stack count, and when the stack count reaches 3, a shockwave is unleashed at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG and consuming all stack counts at the same time. Up to 1 stack count can be gained every 0.1s. A shockwave can be unleashed this way every 4s.
